scene.bubble: Riddle time! A person WHO flies, a place WHERE ships sleep, a thing WHICH rings… Can you guess them all?
scene.intro: Riddle time with Maya and Diego! A person who flies and carries letters. A place where ships stop. A thing which tells you the time. A person who cures animals; a place where you borrow books; a thing which you use to see far away. Diego invents one that nobody can solve, including himself. Write your own riddle with who, which and where — and test your class!

activities.title: Listen to the riddle game. Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Maya: Riddle one! It's a thing which has teeth but never eats. … Diego: Teeth but never eats… a comb! For your hair! … Maya: Correct! Riddle two: it's a place where the books live. … Diego: The library. Too easy! … Maya: Riddle three: a person who works when everyone sleeps. … Diego: Hmm… a baker! They make bread at night. … Maya: Excellent! Last one, the hardest. A thing which gets bigger when you take more away from it. … Diego: What? Bigger when you take away… A HOLE! … Maya: Champion of riddles! Your prize is… inventing the next four riddles.

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the school entrance? The girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass. … Maya: That is Maya. Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy in the red shirt with a microphone? … Maya: That is Diego. Look, Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey. … Diego: And who is the man in the blue shirt? … Maya: That is Mr Vega. Look, Mr Vega is showing the way to the sports centre.
